name: ai-video-gen-tool
description: Local Video Studio desktop client for ComfyUI and LM Studio

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch" "wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist/electron/electron/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
